column1: Dance Barre Design Studio – PLM Workbook v1 (Stage 1: Source of Truth)
Built 2026-10-23 from Elaine Chatwood's files. No invented data: blanks mean the source was blank. Rows carry a SOURCE tag.

column2: Stage 1 of the rollout in the PLM brief: order and style records, supplier directory, fabric inventory with low-stock flags, transactions, purchase orders, BOM/costing and the fit/approval workflow. One workbook acts as the single source of truth until a PLM is chosen. Use it as the migration file for that PLM.

1) Fabric Registry (Sept 13, 2026): Inventory, Lists, Suppliers, Purchases. 2) Order 005 Order Form: description, placements, leotard and pant size breakdowns. 3) Product Development Tracking: orders #1–#40 and Style #s with stage dates. 4) Order 005 sheet: the Production Overview, Sample & Prototype and Grading tabs. Elaine's original files were not changed.
KPIs, the low-stock list, a count of styles by stage, an order summary, the Order 005 fabric check and open review items. Formulas only.

One row per fabric/colour from the registry. Material ID = Fabric#-Colour# (e.g. F001-06). Green columns are formulas: On Hand, Reserved, Available, Projected, Stock Flag and Value. On Hand and Reserved come from Transactions, so never type stock into Materials. Columns AH onward keep the original registry text.

Stock ledger. Types: Receive (+on hand), Issue (−on hand), Return (+on hand), Adjust (± on hand, enter a negative number to reduce), Reserve (+reserved for an order), Unreserve (−reserved). When fabric is cut for an order, log an Issue AND an Unreserve for the same metres. Opening balances are Receive rows dated 2026-09-13 (the registry "as of" date).

Supplier directory. Telio and Pritchard come from the registry Suppliers tab. Ann's Fabric Shop, Rose E Dee and F.L. are named in the Inventory and Purchases tabs but had no supplier record, so their details are blank and flagged "needs data".

PO lines from the registry Purchases tab (Telio 2084720 of Sept 9, 2026, the Ann's order of Sept 5 and the Rose E Dee order of Sept 4). Status, Received (m) and Received Date are for you to fill in. A receipt must also be logged as a Receive transaction. Discrepancy = Received − Ordered.

All orders from the tracking file (#1–#40). Only Order 005 has full header data (Order Form plus Order 005 sheet). Costing: Budget Total, Fabric Cost (from BOM), Accessory Cost and the remainder left for cut & sew.

One row per Style # from the tracking file. Style ID = their Style # (e.g. L1-C-F002-02-26 = Leo #1, Child, fabric F002-02, 2026). Style Key = Order|Style ID|Category is the unique key, because the tracking file reuses L7-C-F001-06-26 for both the Girls and Boys leo in Order 005. Stage columns M–W mirror theirs exactly. Columns X–AH score each stage as done (1) or not (0). A stage counts as done when it holds a date, Yes, N/A, "already…" or "Make in PAD". Blank, "?", "waiting…", "need…", "might…", "No" and "…need to fix" count as not done.

Size breakdown per style, using their size columns plus the long/tall sizes from the Order Form (IC-L, MC-L, SA-L). Child sizes (SC–XLC) go on the -C- style and adult sizes (XSA–XXLA) on the -A- style. The block underneath rebuilds their Female/Male/TOTAL layout and checks it against the Order Form totals.

Fabric lines per style: placement, consumption per unit, units (from Sizes), metres required and cost. Order 005 consumption uses the Order Form estimates. Pant estimates are "1m?", so they are flagged unconfirmed. The contrast fabric ID is deliberately left blank because of the F002-25 / F002-125 conflict (see Needs Review).
Sample/prototype tracking, the prototype approval checklist and the production gates, all from the Order 005 sheet. Statuses and checklist items match theirs.

Printable bin tags, 2 across (A4/Letter portrait). Type or change a Material ID in a tag's ID cell and the rest fills in, including Room/Shelf. The swatch box is left empty: embedded swatch images were not copied because they cause the #VALUE! errors in the registry.
Everything that did not parse cleanly or conflicts between sources. Nothing on this list was guessed. Set Status to Resolved once Elaine answers.

Order # = 3 digits (005). Material ID = Fabric#-Colour# (F001-06). Style ID = studio Style #. Garment versions: Girls / Boys (Female / Male groups). Sizes: SC, IC, IC-L, MC, MC-L, LC, XLC, XSA, SA, SA-L, MA, LA, XLA, XXLA (-L = long/tall). Statuses: Not Started, In Progress, Waiting, Approved, Complete, Hold.

"SOURCE: Order 005 sheet", "SOURCE: Order 005 Order Form", "SOURCE: Fabric Registry (Sept 13, 2026) row N", "SOURCE: Product Development Tracking row N". There are no EXAMPLE rows: every formula has real data to work on.
Dark-blue header = field. Green cell = formula (do not type over it). Grey = original source text kept for traceability. Yellow = needs data or attention.

Elaine's Cut Breakdown and Sewing Production tabs stay as they are for now. In Stage 2: (1) Cut Breakdown 'Qty to Cut' per Garment/Version/Fabric/Size will come from Sizes (SUMIFS by Style Key + size column). Their sheet needs the IC-L / MC-L / SA-L rows added. (2) 'Fabric Req./Unit (m)' will come from BOM Consumption/Unit. (3) 'Fabric Available (m)' will come from Materials Available (m), looked up by Fabric ID. That gives one balance per fabric, instead of a separate figure on every size row. (4) A cut ticket is issued only when the style's Ready to Cut stage is done and BOM Material IDs have no conflict. (5) Cut Qty Actual × consumption posts an Issue + Unreserve to Transactions. (6) Sewing Production tickets (G1/G1B/G2/G2B) will key on Style Key plus size, take Qty Planned from Sizes and feed completed units back to Orders.
Production Season: Fall 2026. Completion: end Nov. 2026 for fittings/rehearsals. Show: Jan. 2027.
